## Goal
Give the screen and the CLI one source for the check-up wording. Add `checkup_lines(cf, ticks, today, days=365) -> list[str]` and `checkup_doc(cf, ticks, profile_id, today, days=365) -> dict` to `checklist_state.py`, built on WO-418. The lines are plain sentences for an older reader: how many steps are done, how many are older than a year, and the titles (`Checklist.title`, `models.py:772-773`) of the steps to look at again, at most 5 then "and N more". The document follows the module's style (`"schema": "checkup/1"`, like `list_doc`, `checklist_state.py:126-132`) with `done`, `total`, `stale` (ids), `due` (bool), `days`, and `first` (the checklist to start with, from `first_checklist`). Pure; not wired into any command (in-house wires the command and the schema).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. For a fake 5-checklist file: nothing done -> one sentence that says nothing is done yet and no "again"; all fresh -> says nothing needs doing again; two stale -> names both titles.
2. With 8 stale steps the lines name 5 titles and say "and 3 more" (singular "1 more").
3. Wording: sentences under 25 words, no "guarantee", "erase", "100%", "safe"; says "do it again" not "expired" or "failed".
4. The document has exactly the keys listed in the goal, values JSON-serialisable, no profile data beyond `profile_id`; `schema == "checkup/1"`.
5. The California DROP step (`DROP_ID`, `checklist_state.py:29`) is listed first among the steps to look at when it is among them and the person is `drop_first` (pass `first`).
6. Titles are never truncated mid-word; a title with quotes or a non-ASCII letter round-trips.
7. Existing checklist_state tests and WO-418 tests pass unchanged.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.
